rows.evidence_gate: Principal approval of scope; machine validation that every included observation resolves to the frame; a negative finding additionally requires symmetric search documentation
rows.prohibited_inference: No claim that the frame is a census; no conversion of missing rows into real-world absence; no denominator borrowed from another frame
rows.purpose: Freeze the universe and denominator for each comparison or negative search
rows.time_semantics: Exact bounded period; unknown endpoints and open years remain explicit

rows.evidence_gate: Underlying fact must exist; function_code requires principal review; legitimation must pass LEG1-LEG3 basis gate; mixed requires component_function_codes; unknown requires missing_scope
rows.prohibited_inference: No actor-level pro/anti-U.S. label; no success inference from intended constraint; no legitimation from donation/service alone; no causality from category counts
rows.purpose: Attach an observable function to a dated fact record without assigning an actor stance
rows.row_grain: one function assignment to one underlying action role or relation observation
rows.time_semantics: Inherits the underlying fact period; function must not be projected beyond that period

rows.evidence_gate: Official award/contract/financial filing/organization financial report or equivalent primary record for confirmed flow; provider recipient direction and amount fields reviewed separately; opportunity-only records excluded
rows.graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both endpoints resolve to registry actors and the transfer is reviewed; otherwise administrative_record aggregate_observation or research_lead
rows.prohibited_inference: No award from NOFO; no direct payment from project cost; no recipient allocation from aggregate amount; no funding chain collapsed across intermediaries; no influence or control from payment alone
rows.purpose: Record a monetary transfer or formal award with typed amount semantics
rows.row_grain: one transfer or one step in a multi-step transaction chain
rows.time_semantics: Exact transaction date filing year fiscal year or bounded period; filing year is not automatically payment date

rows.evidence_gate: Named public role in official filing/organization roster/government or court record; same-person crosswalk requires human review; both role and identity have independent reviewed_fields
rows.graph_eligibility: administrative_record for general person-role observations and case_role for case-specific roles; never dyadic_relation under current v1; a dedicated research-only bipartite renderer requires later schema/adapter approval
rows.prohibited_inference: No same-person merge from name similarity; no continuous tenure from annual sightings; no shared-organization alliance; no actor-actor bridge without reviewed identity and overlapping periods
rows.purpose: Record public person-to-organization roles with identity and temporal uncertainty
rows.row_grain: one person role observation in one actor at one observed date or bounded period
rows.time_semantics: Roster or filing year is observed_at unless source states tenure; open-ended and last-observed bounds remain explicit

rows.evidence_gate: Provider material must name the recipient or a formal program; recipient identity is a separate gate; recurring relation requires multiple dated observations or explicit continuing program evidence
rows.graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both reviewed endpoints resolve to registry actors; administrative_record for a reviewed typed non-actor recipient; aggregate_observation for unresolved/multi-recipient scope; never generic alliance graph
rows.prohibited_inference: No political support alliance dependency or legitimation from receiving a service; no automatic actor creation; no recurring tie from one episode; no monetary amount from in-kind item without valuation basis
rows.purpose: Record services goods equipment relief scholarships referrals or welfare grants to a named or unresolved recipient
rows.row_grain: one provider-recipient service or resource episode
rows.time_semantics: One-off event recurring cycle and ongoing program are distinct; undated roster is observed_at access/publication date only

rows.evidence_gate: Official charter/bylaws/legal filing/organization structure page or equivalent primary record; control type additionally requires explicit appointment ownership veto budget or operational authority
rows.graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both endpoints resolve to registry actors and relation type/direction are reviewed; otherwise administrative_record
rows.prohibited_inference: No control from membership partnership sponsorship or co-presence; no funding from affiliation; no political alignment from shared umbrella; no present relation projected backward
rows.purpose: Separate membership branch operation fiscal sponsorship governance and control relations
rows.row_grain: one structural relation between two typed endpoints
rows.time_semantics: Effective dates if stated; observed_at otherwise; current webpage does not prove uninterrupted historical membership

rows.evidence_gate: Official case caption/judgment/filing/ordinance/program record/dated organization submission or equivalent source; role and outcome reviewed separately
rows.graph_eligibility: case_role event_participation or administrative_record according to scope; only an independently evidenced legal-counsel/structural relation may also be dyadic
rows.prohibited_inference: No actor-actor edge from co-participation or same case; no plaintiff role transferred from person to organization; non_party creates no relation; no project change from intermediate output
rows.purpose: Record how an actor or person enters a case event program or institution and what formal output follows
rows.row_grain: one actor/person role in one action episode and institutional scope
rows.time_semantics: Entry output and substantive change each use their own date/period; event order does not imply causation

rows.evidence_gate: URL opened or archived; officiality supported by site ownership self-identification parent organization government/legal directory or approved equivalent; site type human-reviewed for public release
rows.prohibited_inference: No activity continuity influence capacity or independence from website presence; no news page labeled as official site; no parent page treated as organization-owned site
rows.purpose: Provide a verifiable NGO directory and distinguish official sites from other identity pages
rows.row_grain: one actor-to-site claim at one checked date
rows.time_semantics: checked_at is access observation only; archive date and page publication date remain separate

rows.evidence_gate: Exact identity requires primary or authoritative crosswalk and human review; candidate/ambiguous endpoints retain separate IDs and labels
rows.prohibited_inference: No provisional endpoint promoted to actor; no government program treated as NGO; no facility/locality merge; no name similarity merge; no endpoint role inferred from label
rows.purpose: Type and resolve non-registry people institutions installations cases programs and recipient labels without actor inflation
rows.row_grain: one source endpoint label to one research endpoint candidate or resolved entity
rows.time_semantics: Validity period applies to the label/identity mapping not automatically to organizational existence

rows.evidence_gate: Source ID resolves; locator is precise enough to re-find claim; supported_fields nonempty; independence cluster reviewed when used as second source
rows.prohibited_inference: No whole-row approval from one supported field; no multiple pages on same underlying publication counted as independent sources; no archived status treated as claim approval
rows.purpose: Normalize record-to-source support at field and locator level
rows.time_semantics: Source publication date access date archive date and event date remain separate

rows.condition: Primary key is nonempty and unique within the table
rows.failure_message: Missing or duplicate primary key
rows.remediation: Assign a stable prefixed ID; never renumber accepted rows
rows.why: Stable audit and merges require immutable row identity

rows.condition: selection_frame_id resolves to USN00
rows.failure_message: Observation has no declared selection frame
rows.remediation: Create/approve the selection frame or exclude the row
rows.why: Counts and zero findings need a denominator and inclusion rule

rows.condition: review_status is one of coding_schema_v1 legal values
rows.failure_message: Illegal workflow status
rows.remediation: Send legacy value through human crosswalk
rows.why: Evidence review and display state cannot be inferred from legacy labels

rows.condition: evidence_level review_status human_decision claim_status and graph_eligibility remain separate fields
rows.failure_message: State axes are collapsed or inferred from each other
rows.remediation: Restore all state axes and explicit mapping
rows.why: E4 is not human approval and approval is not graph eligibility

rows.condition: confirmed_scope missing_scope and interpretation_limit are nonempty
rows.failure_message: Bounded claim does not state its bound
rows.remediation: Fill field-level scope after review
rows.why: Users need to know exactly what is confirmed and missing

rows.condition: underlying_record_type and underlying_record_id resolve to a fact table row
rows.failure_message: Function observation has no factual anchor
rows.remediation: Link to a valid fact row or keep as research hypothesis outside USN01
rows.why: Interpretation cannot create its own fact

rows.condition: No actor registry field or actor-level row stores function_code as a fixed stance
rows.failure_message: Function was assigned to an actor rather than an observation
rows.remediation: Move code to a dated underlying action/relation observation
rows.why: Same actor may perform different functions across time and cases

rows.condition: component_function_codes contains at least two non-mixed/non-unknown codes and indivisibility_reason is present
rows.failure_message: Mixed code lacks components or justification
rows.remediation: Decompose the fact or document why it is indivisible
rows.why: Mixed cannot be a vague residual bin

rows.condition: mechanism_status is explicit_strategy_LEG1 observed_reception_LEG2 or measured_effect_LEG3 and matching supported evidence exists
rows.failure_message: Legitimation inferred without the special evidence gate
rows.remediation: Downgrade to garrison_reproduction/community_mediation/unknown as factually warranted or collect explicit frame/reception/effect evidence
rows.why: Charity/service/community mediation alone does not establish legitimation

rows.condition: Claim wording says intent/public frame rather than effect
rows.failure_message: LEG1 evidence is written as achieved legitimacy
rows.remediation: Use bounded intent/frame wording or add LEG2/LEG3 evidence
rows.why: Official framing is not an independent effect evaluation

rows.condition: substantive change is stored separately from objective and intermediate output
rows.failure_message: Intended constraint or formal output was treated as project change
rows.remediation: Set substantive_change_status from direct outcome evidence only
rows.why: Entry and recognition do not prove alteration of military presence

rows.condition: A grant opportunity or NOFO is never encoded as a money flow
rows.failure_message: Opportunity is represented as awarded funding
rows.remediation: Move to research lead/action-program record
rows.why: Opportunity does not identify an award or recipient

rows.condition: provider and recipient direction is supported and reviewed separately
rows.failure_message: Money direction is inferred from context
rows.remediation: Obtain award/financial/organization record or keep as lead
rows.why: Direction is a sensitive factual claim

rows.condition: Numeric amount has currency and amount_semantics; unknown amount is blank not zero
rows.failure_message: Invalid amount representation
rows.remediation: Add currency/semantics or blank unknown amount
rows.why: Zero is a value and cannot represent missing data

rows.condition: project_cost sponsor_tier aggregate_multi_recipient and awarded_ceiling are not labeled direct_payment
rows.failure_message: Non-payment amount was converted into direct money flow
rows.remediation: Correct amount_semantics and graph eligibility
rows.why: Different financial semantics cannot share one edge meaning

rows.condition: Each multi-step chain has unique consecutive flow_step_no and no inferred first-to-last edge
rows.failure_message: Transaction chain is collapsed or ambiguous
rows.remediation: Record each evidenced step and remove synthetic shortcut
rows.why: Intermediaries and downstream allocation must remain visible

rows.condition: Exact shared person_research_id across source labels requires exact_reviewed identity and human reviewed_fields
rows.failure_message: Names were auto-merged
rows.remediation: Split candidate identities and create HR crosswalk
rows.why: Same or similar names do not establish person identity

rows.condition: Roster/filing/event year uses observed_at unless explicit tenure dates are sourced
rows.failure_message: Annual observation was expanded into continuous tenure
rows.remediation: Change period_semantics or add tenure source
rows.why: Annual records are lower-bound sightings

rows.condition: Actor-actor person projection uses only reviewed identities roles and overlapping periods
rows.failure_message: Organizations were linked through unreviewed or non-overlapping people
rows.remediation: Keep bipartite view or restrict to reviewed overlap
rows.why: A shared name or different-year role does not prove an interface

rows.condition: recipient_label_source is preserved even when recipient_endpoint_id resolves
rows.failure_message: Original recipient label was overwritten
rows.remediation: Restore source label and separate resolution fields
rows.why: Crosswalk must remain auditable

rows.condition: Unresolved or composite recipient uses aggregate_observation and cannot enter dyadic graph
rows.failure_message: Unknown recipient appears as an organization edge
rows.remediation: Downgrade graph eligibility and retain raw label
rows.why: Unknown/composite endpoints are not actors

rows.condition: One service episode is not coded recurring without repeated dates or explicit continuing-program evidence
rows.failure_message: Single event was expanded to stable relation
rows.remediation: Use one-off period semantics or add repeated evidence
rows.why: Occurrence does not establish continuity

rows.condition: Recipient relation carries no alliance stance dependency or legitimation field by default
rows.failure_message: Recipient was treated as political ally/supporter
rows.remediation: Remove derived political fields and use USN01 gate if evidence exists
rows.why: Receiving welfare/resources does not establish political alignment

rows.condition: relation_type governance_control has a nonempty control_dimension and explicit governance source
rows.failure_message: Control is inferred without formal authority
rows.remediation: Downgrade to membership/affiliation or add formal governance evidence
rows.why: Control requires appointment ownership veto budget or operational evidence

rows.condition: umbrella membership branch operator fiscal sponsorship and control use distinct relation types and endpoint roles
rows.failure_message: Structural relations are collapsed
rows.remediation: Retype relation and roles
rows.why: Membership does not equal operation control or funding

rows.condition: Case/event/program participants remain attached to scope nodes; co-participation does not generate actor dyads
rows.failure_message: Co-occurrence was converted to organization relation
rows.remediation: Remove dyad and restore case/event node
rows.why: Joint presence is event participation not alliance

rows.condition: non_party has graph_eligibility case_role or excluded and creates no dyadic relation
rows.failure_message: Non-party created a relationship edge
rows.remediation: Remove dyadic edge
rows.why: Negative case role is not collaboration

rows.condition: Person case role is not transferred to an affiliated organization without organization-specific evidence
rows.failure_message: Person role was attributed to organization
rows.remediation: Keep person endpoint or obtain organization caption/record
rows.why: Person is not organization

rows.condition: site_type and officiality_basis distinguish owned official site parent page government/legal directory program page archive and secondary reference
rows.failure_message: All identity URLs are labeled official websites
rows.remediation: Retype and human-review officiality
rows.why: Directory/news/parent pages have different provenance meanings

rows.condition: checked_at archive date publication date and organization active period are not conflated
rows.failure_message: Access date is used as activity/continuity date
rows.remediation: Separate time fields and bound claim
rows.why: Web availability is not organizational continuity

rows.condition: Provisional endpoints do not receive registry actor IDs without a separate human actor decision
rows.failure_message: Research endpoint was auto-promoted to actor
rows.remediation: Keep research endpoint ID and create actor HR task if warranted
rows.why: Graph convenience cannot expand the registry

rows.condition: Facility locality program public institution person and organization endpoint kinds remain distinct
rows.failure_message: Different endpoint types were merged
rows.remediation: Split endpoints and restore type-specific IDs
rows.why: Type errors create false organization relations

rows.condition: Every source support row has a precise locator and nonempty supported_fields
rows.failure_message: Source reference does not say what or where it supports
rows.remediation: Add page/section/entry locator and fields
rows.why: Field-level review is impossible without locators

rows.condition: Sources counted as independent second sources have distinct source_independence_cluster values reviewed by a human
rows.failure_message: Same underlying publication was double-counted
rows.remediation: Cluster related sources and revise evidence gate
rows.why: Multiple pages/mirrors are not independent evidence

rows.condition: A frozen USN00 frame symmetric bidirectional search log source-family coverage and separate organization/person/recipient measures exist
rows.failure_message: Unencoded relation is stated as real-world absence
rows.remediation: Report only bounded unencoded observation or complete the negative-evidence gate
rows.why: A database zero may be a sampling or source-silo artifact

rows.condition: network_metric_eligibility is not_eligible unless one layer has frozen universe period reviewed endpoints/direction/time missingness and sensitivity report
rows.failure_message: Centrality/density run on an ineligible graph
rows.remediation: Complete gate or limit output to navigation
rows.why: Mixed and incomplete networks produce misleading rankings

rows.condition: Candidate rows are excluded from primary metric and appear only in a labeled sensitivity upper bound
rows.failure_message: Candidate edge entered primary centrality
rows.remediation: Split reviewed and candidate scenarios
rows.why: Candidate is not a fact

rows.condition: Source-family deletion unresolved-endpoint and time-window sensitivity outputs accompany centrality
rows.failure_message: Metric lacks visibility-bias sensitivity

rows.why: Current project has documented source concentration

rows.condition: Degree/betweenness/community results are worded as bounded public-record structure not influence control or power
